description: This file defines API route handlers for authentication and user management within a FastAPI application. It includes user registration, login, profile retrieval, and organization switching functionalities, utilizing dependency injection, database operations, and JWT token handling.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Response model containing access token and user organization info.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Model representing user profile information including memberships and active organization.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: Model representing user's membership in an organization.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Request model for user registration including email, password, full name, and organization name.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Request model for user login, including email and password.

classes.name: SwitchOrgRequest
classes.description: Request model for switching the active organization.

methods.name: dict _get_current_user(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Extracts and verifies user payload from Bearer token in request headers.

methods.name: TokenResponse register(data: RegisterRequest = Body(...))
methods.description: Handles user registration, organization creation, membership assignment, and token issuance.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(data: LoginRequest = Body(...))
methods.description: Authenticates user and issues a JWT token upon successful login.

methods.name: UserProfile me(payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns current user's profile including memberships and active organization.

methods.name: TokenResponse switch_org( data: SwitchOrgRequest = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user), )
methods.description: Switches user's active organization and returns a new JWT token reflecting the change.

ctags.name: switch_org
ctags.signature: ( data: SwitchOrgRequest = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user), )
